mod.name: CatLib
mod.description: Foundation library for Cat Mail Co. mods.

setting.Diagnostics.CrashWindow.description: When the game closes unexpectedly, a small window shows what happened and a report with the logs is kept in BepInEx/CatLib/Crashes.
setting.Diagnostics.CrashDumps.description: Together with the crash window, keeps a memory dump of the moment of the crash in the report folder, for the mod authors. The crash watcher follows the game like a debugger for this.
setting.Diagnostics.CrashSymbols.description: Lets the crash watcher download the public symbols of Unity and Windows once per version, so crash reports name the functions of UnityPlayer.dll and other modules. They are kept in BepInEx/CatLib/Symbols.
setting.Network.Enabled.description: Exchange mod lists and session settings with other players who use CatLib. Takes effect from the next session.
setting.Network.OnIncompatiblePlayer.description: What the host does when a joining player's mods do not match: let the player in and pause the mods that not everyone has, or disconnect the player.
setting.Network.SteamApi.description: How CatLib calls Steam. Change it only when asked to while diagnosing a problem. Takes effect from the next session.
setting.DevTools.MenuHotkey.description: Opens the developer menu when a mod has registered developer commands, for example CatLib.Tests.

ui.HoverHint: Point at a setting to see its description

ui.PackEnabledHint: Turns the pack on or off. In a game with other players a pack works only when every player has it on.
ui.PackFolderHint: Opens the folder of the pack with its files.
ui.PackBuildHint: Makes a zip of the pack, ready to upload to Thunderstore: manifest, README and a 256x256 icon included. It goes to BepInEx/CatLib/Packages.
ui.PackBadName: the name needs Latin letters or digits, add a line package: MyPack
ui.PackNoIcon: there is no icon.png and no image to make one from

ui.BuildOlder: Your game is older, update it in Steam
